propDocs.ImageCropper.mode: Box moves a crop over the image; frame pans the image under a fixed crop.
propDocs.ImageCropper.aspectRatio: Locks width divided by height; omit for a free crop.
propDocs.ImageCropper.disabled: Disables crop dragging, keyboard controls, zoom, rotate and flip.
propDocs.ImageCropper.minWidth: Smallest crop width in image pixels.
propDocs.ImageCropper.minHeight: Smallest crop height in image pixels.
